Rezept.et: From earlier Recept, recept, from Latin receptus, thus cognate with English receipt.

rezitieren.et: Borrowed from Latin recitāre, infinitive of recitō (“to read aloud, recite”).

Rezitativ.et: Borrowed from French récitatif, from Italian recitativo.

s: critique, review (of a work of art)
reception (desk of a hotel or office where guests are received)
recent; of or from a time not long ago
creator of a recension of a text
Rezensent.et: From Latin recēnsens (“reviewer”), from recēnseō (“review”), from re- + cēnseō (“give an opinion”).

s: to review (to write a critical evaluation of a new art work etc.; to write a review)
